limitations: SLES 12 SP5 userspace on WSL2 kernel, not the SLES kernel or old CPU hardware.
One client and modern controlled server; no cross-client fencing or server reboot/power-loss evidence.

Real Rust runtime cases cover selected claim, source-read, copy-write, verification-read, publication and manifest-link points; long outages, interrupted claim/file link intermediates and export changes remain unqualified. Other lock/startup probes use OS tools.
Service startup rejection is measured; production NFS and source deletion remain disabled.
